Initial release of the Engineering Manager OS skill, providing a comprehensive, actionable operating system for engineering team leaders.

- Robust 1:1 system: templates, cadences, action rules, and a deep question bank.
- Practical frameworks for flight risk detection and retention conversations.
- Performance calibration matrix for clear evaluations of delivery and behavior.
- Not generic advice—detailed, ready-to-run playbooks for new managers through director-level leadership.
